title: Albert Nicholas and Fletcher Henderson recordings
summary: Nicholas was with Luis Russell in 1929-30; he recorded King Porter Stomp with Henderson.

blocks.x: When did you first meet with Albert Nicholas?
He was with Luis Russel's band.
So that was back in the 30s or something like that?
And you recorded King Porter's song with Fletcher ... Stomp,
And, was it the Sugarfoot Stomp, too?
I think I made that with Louis Armstrong. I don't know, but I made it with somebody.
